title: Ocean City Life Saving Station

services.name: Group Tour
services.desc: Give your students a hands-on learning experience exploring the cultural and natural history of Ocean City, Maryland. During your visit, students will learn about the heroic efforts of the U.S. Life-Saving Service and discover the tools and techniques used to rescue mariners in distress. We also offer an engaging aquarium program, where students can meet some of the local marine life that call our waters home. Animals on exhibit include seahorses, a horseshoe crab, a diamondback terrapin, and various native fish. services.name: Museum of Ocean City Rental
services.desc: Looking for a unique and memorable venue for your next event? The Museum of Ocean City offers a charming and historic setting perfect for gatherings of up to 40 guests. Whether you’re planning a meeting, celebration, or special occasion, our rental packages are flexible and affordable: $350 for a half-day (4 hours) or $600 for a full day (8 hours), plus a $100 cleaning fee. Discounts are available for non-profits/heritage non-profit organizations and Museum Members. Your rental includes access to the first-floor exhibit hall, tables, chairs, Wi-Fi, and accessible restrooms, with the freedom to bring in your own caterer to create the perfect experience.
